cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer (Property & Infrastructure) role in Adelaide, which I saw on SEEK. Your advert says the graduate will gain exposure to concept, feasibility and detailed design work, including stormwater drainage, erosion control and crossings for waterways, pipelines, rail and roads.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a Project in Charge Engineer and then a Field Engineer. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, carried out site inspections, safety and quality checks, tracked procurement and prepared progress reports. In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Marc Masarate
